parameters.description: Specifies how much information to show for the electronic signature. The minimal view returns only electronic signature information currently available. Specifying anything else defaults to all information. It is recommended to use minimal when querying multiple records.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"account_type\":\"manual\",\"prostore_file_id\":0,\"redirect_path\":\"string\"}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/electronic_signatures?company_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&object_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&object_type=SOME_STRING_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()

x-changelog.summary: Add account_type and prostore_file_id params to create endpoint
x-changelog.description: Added account_type and prostore_file_id request body params to POST /electronic_signatures. Passing account_type: "manual" with a prostore_file_id creates an electronic signature record backed by a pre-uploaded signed document, without requiring DocuSign or ProcoreSign to be configured.

x-changelog.summary: Made Create electronic signature endpoint public
Add redirect_path param and async PDF generation responses to create endpoint
x-changelog.description: Added the redirect_path request body param to POST /electronic_signatures. Once ASYNC_PDF_ON_SIGN_FLAG is enabled for a company, a still-generating PDF returns 202 with the electronic signature record instead of 201 with an iframe URL, and a concurrent request for the same object returns 409. Integrations must handle 202 and 409 before the flag is enabled for their company.
Adds the "created_at" and "updated_at" timestamp fields, in ISO 8601 format.
